title: Egeria
summary: Raleigh names Egeria in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Egeria, a Nymph, with whom Numa perswaded the Romans that he had familiaritie, and who taught him the Ceremonies which he deliuered. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. VI, sig. 368a–368b
